bound_domain: active new tensor-buffer capacity; original Q/K/V/mask/sink residency excluded from incremental peaks; at most F32 per floating element; page rounding and bounded oversized buffer reuse; no tensor donation assumption
derivation: Execution and inspection share the input-score row budget (8192), query-step selection and 256-key tile. Above 8192 keys each query uses a normalization pass followed by a rounded-probability value pass.

Each block prices grouped key/value expansion and casts, QK product, score rounding/scaling/cap, allowed-mask construction, explicit boolean or additive mask handling, F32 scores, both reductions/normalization recurrence or probability/value recurrence. Both full blocks and a partial final block are considered.

The existing Recovery owner surrounds each accumulator step and establishes successful exact native ownership retirement before another block. Metal callback-owned temporaries are released before that native frontier. Array readiness alone would not justify the maximum-block bound. Errors return without a false terminal assertion and existing recovery retains unresolved resources.

Let O be one query-output buffer capacity and C the maximum new-buffer cost across normalization/value passes and full/tail blocks. During block execution charge C, one query cast, two old row-normalization buffers, one old value accumulator and at most 2*(Q-1)*O for previous query outputs/conversions. Separately charge 2*Q*O and the concatenated output for the final phase. The operation bound is the maximum of those phases.

All intermediate shapes and byte arithmetic are checked. The public trace charges the output once and the remaining peak as operation scratch. Host allocation metadata and temporary Rust vectors are outside this tensor-buffer domain.

validation.cold_bound_behavior: At Q=1,2,17, all mask/sink/cap combinations have identical completed-block bounds at K=8193,16385,32769,65537; finished-query storage remains charged.

numerical_reference.precision_note: Host equation does not emulate every F16/BF16 rounding boundary. Existing independent explicit-rounding fixtures passed in the separate attention regression suite.

The test now waits, with the existing ten-second retirement deadline, for actual directory cleanup; production cleanup behavior is unchanged. All 29 cache tests then passed.
